class TestSpecialityWiseConsultations(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_speciality_wise_number_of_consultations_month(self):
        # Arrange
        doctor_id = "D001"
        month = "2023-04"
        expected_count = 10

        # Act
        result = get_speciality_wise_number_of_consultations(doctor_id, month)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(result, expected_count)

    def test_speciality_wise_revenue_earned_month(self):
        # Arrange
        doctor_id = "D001"
        month = "2023-04"
        expected_revenue = 5000

        # Act
        result = get_speciality_wise_revenue_earned(doctor_id, month)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(result, expected_revenue)

class TestConsultationRequests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_patient_creates_appointment_request(self):
        # Arrange
        patient_id = "P001"
        symptoms = "Fever"
        mode = "Appointment"
        expected_request_id = "R001"

        result = create_consultation_request(patient_id, symptoms, mode)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(result, expected_request_id)

    def test_patient_creates_offline_request(self):
        # Arrange
        patient_id = "P001"
        symptoms = "Cough"
        mode = "Offline"
        expected_request_id = "R002"

        # Act

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(result, expected_request_id)

class TestChemistPrescriptions(unittest.TestCase):

        # Act
        result = get_chemist_prescriptions(chemist_id)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(result, expected_prescriptions)

    def test_chemist_updates_prescription_status(self):

        prescription_id = "P001"
